Name: Drorie's Krobus Cows
Author: Drorie
Description:
Do you like Krobus? Do you wish he was a cow? Well this is what this mod is here for. It adds a new type of cow called the Krobus Cow.

Krobus Cows are introverted in nature, and prefer the indoors. That doesn't make them impossible to befriend, however. If one warms up to you enough, it will begin to produce Krobus Milk. Krobus Milk is just like normal milk, except it comes from Krobus Cows.

Of course, you can make Krobus Cheese from Krobus Milk also. But why would you do that? That's really weird.

Perfect for a witchy/gothic type of farm!

Downloads.Description: Adds Krobus Cows to Stardew Valley
